content.value: The pointer in figure Q1(c) consists of a rod equipped with two reflective markers (12) A and B. The locations of the two reflective markers are provided by a camerabased motion capture system. Given marker locations A = (629,-35,190)mm and B = (669,191,120)mm, determine the location of the pointer tip, T, if marker B is a fixed distance, D, of 127mm from the pointer tip.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
